title: Forge
description:
Four agents: Recon for parsing into AST, Analysis that runs cppcheck and cling-tidy that, Patch which writes LLM-generated diff patches, and Validation which applies the diff.
Compiled at the end with sanitizers in a Docker sandbox. Each pass knows the information from previous agents in a shared state. Prevented infinite LLM cycle with a 3-loop limit, then escalate to the user with known information.
